goal_clarity.comments: Workflow objective and success criteria are clearly defined.

input_completeness.comments: All required inputs are explicitly documented.

decision_explicitness.comments: Business rules are represented as explicit decision rules.

workflow_structure.comments: Workflow follows a clear sequence of states and transitions.

exception_handling.comments: Common exceptions are handled, with room for additional edge cases.

reusability.comments: Workflow is reusable across interfaces and AI agents.

governance_readiness.comments: Workflow includes ownership, versioning, and lifecycle metadata.

improvement_opportunities: Expand exception handling for additional business scenarios.
Include workflow performance metrics as the system evolves.
recommendation: Approved as a reusable workflow definition.
